vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.title: The Unbroken Wall
vanguard.desc: Durable frontline fighter. Soaks hits, then repays them with interest.
vanguard.lore: Last captain of a sunken garrison, Brannoch holds the line because nobody else will. Every blow he endures is a debt the enemy will pay.
vanguard.mech_desc: Taking damage charges the Bulwark meter. Spend it with Retaliate for a counter-strike that grows with the meter.
vanguard.passive_desc: Knockback taken is reduced by 25%. At 50+ Bulwark, damage taken is reduced by 10%.
vanguard.strengths: Survives pressure, protects allies, huge payoff for being hit.
vanguard.weaknesses: Slow. Ranged enemies kite him. Retaliate has a visible wind-up.
vanguard.strategy: Walk forward, let Bulwark build, then Retaliate. Save the ultimate to shield the whole team.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.title: Edge of the Moment
duelist.desc: Fast fencer who snowballs through unbroken combos.
duelist.lore: Ilsa Verrane fought a hundred duels for coin and lost none. She never stops moving, because stillness is how duellists die.
duelist.mech_desc: Every hit adds a Momentum stack (max 5, +5% damage and +3% speed each). Taking a hit halves them.
duelist.passive_desc: Each hit you land shortens the Sidestep cooldown by 0.25s.
duelist.strengths: Highest burst with stacks, great mobility, can cancel attacks into Sidestep.
duelist.weaknesses: Low health. Loses everything if hit while stacking.
duelist.strategy: Thrust, Quick Slash, Sidestep out. At 3+ stacks Phantom Step refunds Quick Slash. Ultimate is a guaranteed-feeling finisher - use it on a staggered target.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.title: Patient Hunter
ranger.desc: Bow marksman who rewards standing your ground and picking a target.
ranger.lore: Sel of the Hollow Wood has never missed a shot she took her time on. She marks her quarry once, then waits.
ranger.mech_desc: Hunter's Mark tags an enemy for 6s: all your damage to them is +25%. Marked hits also charge your ultimate faster.
ranger.passive_desc: Standing still for 0.7s lines up the next arrow for +50% damage.
ranger.strengths: Longest range, strong zoning, big damage on marked or still targets.
ranger.weaknesses: Fragile. Moving cancels Steady Aim. Slow wind-ups.
ranger.strategy: Mark, plant your feet, fire. Dash back when they close in.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.title: Six Chambers
gunslinger.desc: Cylinder-fed shooter who must manage ammunition to keep up the pressure.
gunslinger.lore: Dust Calloway has exactly six bullets and an opinion about every one. Run dry and the legend ends.
gunslinger.mech_desc: Six rounds. Pistol costs 1, Quick Burst 3, Explosive Round 2. Empty = 1.6s forced reload; otherwise rounds slowly refill when you stop shooting.
gunslinger.passive_desc: Tactical Roll reloads 2 rounds and grants a short speed boost.
gunslinger.strengths: Constant pressure, three firing patterns, rolling reload.
gunslinger.weaknesses: Dry chamber leaves him helpless. Low health.
gunslinger.strategy: Mix single shots with a burst, roll to reload, finish with an Explosive Round. Dead Eye ignores the ammo limit.

arcanist.name: Arcanist
arcanist.title: Weaver of Elements
arcanist.desc: Elemental caster who switches element to combine effects.
arcanist.lore: Orsolya burned her academy library to learn what the books were afraid of. She now carries three flames in one staff.
arcanist.mech_desc: Attune cycles Fire, Frost and Storm. Spells use mana. Fire on a slowed target SHATTERS (+50%). Storm chains to a nearby enemy and stuns a slowed target.
arcanist.passive_desc: Mana regenerates twice as fast while you stand still.
arcanist.strengths: Flexible damage, chain and slow control, devastating ultimate.
arcanist.weaknesses: Low health, mana runs out, must plan the element order.
arcanist.strategy: Frost to slow, Attune, Fire to shatter. Storm when two enemies stand close together.

shadeweaver.name: Shadeweaver
shadeweaver.title: Hollow Trickster
shadeweaver.desc: Shadow controller who never stands where the enemy thinks.
shadeweaver.lore: Nobody remembers Vesh's face; the Rift took it as payment. What remains is a cloak, a scythe and a talent for being elsewhere.
shadeweaver.mech_desc: Shadow builds while you move and hit. Spend it on Binding Chains and Shadow Echo: teleport forward leaving an echo, press again within 3s to swap back.
shadeweaver.passive_desc: +8% move speed, and basic attacks deal up to +40% damage as Shadow fills. Rooted enemies become immune to roots for 2.5s.
shadeweaver.strengths: Slippery, strong control, great reposition options.
shadeweaver.weaknesses: Needs movement to fuel Shadow. Modest raw damage. Hardest to play.
shadeweaver.strategy: Keep moving, chain a target, Echo behind them, Eclipse to lock the whole group briefly.

riftblade.name: Riftblade
riftblade.title: Seam-Walker
riftblade.lore: Kael Nox cuts doors in the air and walks through them. Where he steps out, nobody is looking.
riftblade.mech_desc: Phase builds slowly and on every hit. Rift Step costs 40 and tears a rift to exit BEHIND the nearest enemy with a backstab. Hits from behind deal +30%.
riftblade.passive_desc: Attacks from behind the target deal +30% damage.
riftblade.strengths: Unexpected angles, high burst from behind, great mobility.
riftblade.weaknesses: Low defence; needs Phase for Rift Step; punished if the exit is read.
riftblade.strategy: Poke with Dimensional Slash, Phase Dash through attacks, Rift Step behind them, Rift Cut, repeat. Ultimate gathers a group.

warden.name: Warden
warden.title: Keeper of the Line
warden.lore: Hesper Dray plants wards where friends will stand. She has never lost someone standing in one.
warden.mech_desc: Ward energy (+3/s) pays for Guardian Ward: a zone where you and allies take 35% less damage. The ultimate dome is bigger (60%).
warden.passive_desc: Allies within 300px take 10% less damage (the ward stacks on top).
warden.strengths: Best team protection, strong peel, very durable.
warden.weaknesses: Low damage, slow, ward can be walked away from.
warden.strategy: Plant a ward where the fight will be, stand in it, Pulse enemies away. Aegis Dome turns a team fight.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.title: Thunder's Voice
stormcaller.lore: Oriel Vane speaks the language of storms and the storms answer, sometimes too loudly.
stormcaller.mech_desc: Spark and Lightning Bolt build Charge. Discharge spends it all as chain lightning that jumps up to 3 enemies.
stormcaller.passive_desc: Standing within 350px of an enemy builds +4 Charge per second.
stormcaller.strengths: Excellent against groups, fast bolts, builds power by fighting.
stormcaller.weaknesses: Fragile, weak when uncharged, Discharge has a wind-up.
stormcaller.strategy: Stay near the fight, spark and bolt to charge, Discharge on grouped enemies, Tempest to finish.

reaper.name: Reaper
reaper.title: Harvest Bound
reaper.lore: Mourne collects what the battlefield leaves behind, and never takes more than the field can spare.
reaper.mech_desc: Hits gather Souls. Spend them on Soul Siphon for a heal, or hit with Soul Rend for burst. All healing shares a limit of about 25 HP per 10 seconds.
reaper.passive_desc: Basic attacks heal 8% of the damage dealt (inside the healing limit).
reaper.strengths: Wins long fights, flexible heal or burst, tough.
reaper.weaknesses: Healing is capped, slow ranged approach, needs to keep hitting.
reaper.strategy: Fill Souls with sweeps, Soul Rend a staggered target, Siphon when low. Death's Harvest heals from groups.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.title: Borrowed Seconds
chronomancer.lore: Tamsin Orrel spends tomorrow's seconds today, and always stays one payment ahead of the interest.
chronomancer.mech_desc: Time energy (+8/s) pays for Time Snare (slow), Temporal Bubble (slows enemies and enemy projectiles) and Time Skip. Everything is deterministic and costs energy.
chronomancer.strengths: Controls tempo, great at denying projectiles, flexible movement.
chronomancer.weaknesses: Low damage and health, energy gates everything.
chronomancer.strategy: Snare, Bubble the lane, Skip away from trouble. Hourglass for the decisive push.

beastbound.name: Beastbound
beastbound.title: Pack Mother
beastbound.lore: Runa Hale never fights alone. The wolf follows, the wolf bites, the wolf is family.
beastbound.mech_desc: Call of the Pack summons a wolf for 10s that follows you and bites enemies. Sic 'Em orders a lunge. Alpha Howl sends the pack into a 6s frenzy.
beastbound.passive_desc: While the wolf is out you move 8% faster and deal 10% more damage.
beastbound.strengths: Two-front pressure, strong close range, ultimate burst.
beastbound.weaknesses: Weak without the wolf; the wolf is time-limited; lunge can be dodged.
beastbound.strategy: Call the wolf early, Pounce in, Sic 'Em, Claw Slash. Howl when the wolf is on top of them.
